name: Select FDA Regulatory Pathway and Build Submission Checklist
prompt:
You are a regulatory affairs manager evaluating three new medical device products for FDA market clearance. For each product, determine the correct FDA regulatory pathway and produce structured output files.

Products to evaluate:

Product 1: SurgiGrip Clamp
- Intended use: Surgical tissue clamp for general laparoscopic procedures
- Device class: Class II
- Predicate available: Yes (K193421, substantially equivalent intended use and technology)
- Clinical data: Not required (standard bench testing available)
- Technology: Standard mechanical; no software

Product 2: NeuralScan AI
- Intended use: AI-based software to detect early-stage Alzheimer's from MRI scans (SaMD)
- Device class: Class II
- Predicate available: No (novel AI algorithm for this indication)
- Risk level: Low-Moderate
- Clinical data: May be required

Product 3: CardioValve Pro
- Intended use: Transcatheter heart valve replacement for high-risk surgical patients
- Device class: Class III
- Predicate available: No
- Clinical data: Required (IDE study needed)
- Risk level: High

Step 1: For each product, determine the FDA pathway (510(k), De Novo, or PMA) and save to pathway_analysis.json.

For each product include: product_id (P1, P2, P3), name, pathway ("510(k)" or "De Novo" or "PMA"), rationale (2-3 sentences explaining the selection), estimated_review_days (90 for 510k, 150 for De Novo, 180 for PMA), user_fee_category ("~$22K" for 510k, "~$135K" for De Novo, "~$440K" for PMA), and requires_presub_meeting (true/false — true if novel technology, uncertain predicate, or complex testing).

Save as: { "products": [ { "product_id": "...", "name": "...", "pathway": "...", "rationale": "...", "estimated_review_days": N, "user_fee_category": "...", "requires_presub_meeting": bool }, ... ] }

Step 2: For the 510(k) product only, generate a submission checklist and save to submission_checklist.json.

The checklist must include all 9 standard sections: Cover letter, Administrative information, Device description, Intended use and indications, Substantial equivalence comparison, Performance testing, Biocompatibility summary, Labeling, Summary and conclusion. For each section include: section_number (1-9), title, status ("Required"), and a brief description of what to include (1 sentence).

Save as: { "product": "SurgiGrip Clamp", "submission_type": "510(k)", "sections": [ { "section_number": N, "title": "...", "status": "Required", "description": "..." }, ... ] }

criteria.description: pathway_analysis.json exists in the working directory.
pathway_analysis.json products array contains exactly 3 entries with IDs P1, P2, and P3.
Product P1 (SurgiGrip Clamp) has pathway '510(k)' and estimated_review_days of 90.
Product P2 (NeuralScan AI) has pathway 'De Novo' and estimated_review_days of 150.
Product P3 (CardioValve Pro) has pathway 'PMA' and estimated_review_days of 180.
Each product entry has a rationale string (>20 chars) and a boolean requires_presub_meeting field.
criteria.testPattern: each product has rationale and requires_presub_meeting fields

criteria.description: submission_checklist.json exists in the working directory.
submission_checklist.json sections array contains exactly 9 entries numbered 1 through 9.
Each checklist section has a title string, status='Required', and a non-empty description string; submission_type is '510(k)' and product matches 'SurgiGrip'.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent selected FDA regulatory pathways for three medical devices and built a 510(k) submission checklist.

Criterion 1: Pathway Selection Correctness (Weight: 60%)
1.0: P1=510(k) (predicate available, Class II, SE supportable), P2=De Novo (no predicate but low-moderate risk novel device), P3=PMA (Class III, high-risk, no predicate, clinical data required). Rationales are accurate and cite the correct factors. Review days and fees match the pathway.
0.5: 2 of 3 pathway selections are correct with reasonable rationales.
0: Pathway selections are wrong or rationales do not match the device facts.

Criterion 2: Checklist Completeness (Weight: 40%)
1.0: All 9 sections are present in the correct order with accurate titles and meaningful descriptions of required content per FDA 510(k) format.
0.5: At least 7 sections present with mostly accurate descriptions.
0: Fewer than 5 sections or sections do not correspond to 510(k) format.
